key_insight: Detonation-spraying parameters can tune the roughness, thickness, and hydrophobicity of titanium dioxide–based metal-ceramic coatings.
engineering_relevance: The reported relationships can guide spray-condition selection to target coating geometry and maximize water repellency.
method: Evaluate coating roughness, thickness, and contact angle.
Derive equations linking surface properties to nozzle speed and spray distance.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports inverse-power relationships between nozzle passage speed and roughness/thickness, parabolic relationships between spray distance and roughness/contact angle, and conditions for maximum hydrophobicity.
watch_item: The abstract provides no numerical process window, fit accuracy, or validation data, limiting direct transfer to production.
paper_title: Surface Characteristics of Titanium Based Coatings Obtained by Detonation Spraying Under Various Process Conditions
